gen-gf-wallpoet-manrope: Commanding Wallpoet rises tall in its lowercase and lets paper show between its letters, while Manrope keeps every curve bright and open. Manrope's low-key capitals let the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-warnes-montserrat: Expressive Warnes stretches its tracking wide and lets each ink stroke taper out before it touches the next. And Montserrat's generous curves glide under the eye like wire, so longer text keeps moving.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One sits quietly, its capitals and lowercase nearly the same height. Wide gaps between letters let long text drift along slowly, while Grandstander keeps its heading punchy with constant-width lines and a tall x-height.
gen-luckiest-guy-switzer: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, its mean line set high and its ink looking freshly poured. But Switzer's tubular, wire-like letters are the real draw, their c tips never creeping toward touching.
gen-megrim-work-sans: Megrim looks angular and futuristic, with an x-height that soars skyward. Work Sans follows with joins that match its strokes and c tips that stay apart, so extended reading moves along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, trustworthy in a quiet way. Mystery Quest then adds a bookish, nostalgic lean with open-jawed curves that give the sans-serif text something to play against.
gen-press-start-2p-general-sans: Press Start 2P goes fun and retro, its letters pinned far apart like cut-outs and its bowls looking open. General Sans fills the line with a smooth, steady stroke, so longer text glides along.
gen-righteous-fs-supreme: Bent like thin steel rod, Righteous lets its bowls fill the whole line with commanding fun. Supreme brings crisp, heavy-looking text with letters held open, and that weight is what makes the pair hold.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-cascadia-mono: Distinctive Gugi lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height and cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Gugi has the attitude, Cascadia Mono the tidy pin-straight rows.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga spaces its flat, single-weight letters so generously that every word opens up. Lexend Giga stays out of Audiowide's way, letting its tile-like, wide-grouted letters carry the futuristic personality.
